The Tidal Maze

You’re a blue crab. Scuttle left or right along the mud with the mouse, arrow keys, A/D, or joystick.

Stop beside a mussel to crack it. Collect five, then reach the gate on the right at high tide. Pale sandbars block crossings at low tide. When the fish winds up, dash away or hold Shift, right-click, or Stealth over dark mud to bury yourself.

YOUR FIRST SWIM

Little fish. Big lake.

Swim & boost. Drag your left thumb on the left half to steer. Hold DASH to swim faster; release to refill stamina. Both thumbs can work together.

Eat, then explore. Start with glowing food and fish marked with a green dot. Bigger fish carry a warning. Your first goal: grow from 0.5 to 50 lbs.

Hide to survive. Swim into the reeds and look for “In cover.” Hold STEALTH to move cautiously. Reach 4 lbs and find a glowing mate for an extra life.

Be careful with bait. Nibble hook bait cautiously when craving rises. If hooked, tap DASH rapidly to escape. Below 8 lbs you get thrown back; at 8 lbs or more, being reeled in ends your run.

Desktop controls

Mouse or WASD / arrows to steer. Hold left-click or Space to boost. Shift or right-click for stealth. Click or press Space repeatedly to escape hooks. P / Escape pauses.

Pause anytime with Ⅱ. Reopen this guide from “How to play.” New chapters explain their own goals.

    LAKE MONARCH

    Grow from a nimble minnow into the undisputed apex ruler of the lake.

    • Swim: Drag your left thumb on the left half of the screen. Hold DASH with your right thumb to boost; release to recharge. Play portrait or landscape.
    • Eat & Grow: Swallow smaller fish and bugs. Hide in green weed beds to break predator line-of-sight.
    • The Hook Gamble: Your Bait Craving rises over time. Hold STEALTH and approach bait from below to cut hook risk. If hooked, tap DASH repeatedly to escape.
    • Catch & Release: Under 8.0 lbs, anglers throw you back if reeled in. At 8.0+ lbs, getting reeled in is Game Over!
    • Mate for Extra Lives: Reach 4.0 lbs and swim near a glowing mate in the shallows to spawn fry checkpoints.
    • Victory: Reach 50.0 lbs to become the Lake Monarch.
    Playing on desktop?

    Steer with your mouse or WASD / arrows. Hold left-click or Space to boost. Hold Shift or right-click for stealth. When hooked, click or tap Space repeatedly. Press P or Escape to pause.
